description_en: Changes the expiration time of the classic network endpoint of an instance in hybrid access mode
description_zh: 该接口用于修改混访模式下经典网络地址的过期时间
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-network-expire-time --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --classic-expired-days 7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceNetworkExpireTime

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The classic network endpoint whose expiration time you want to extend. Two types of classic network endpoints are supported:

*   The internal endpoint of the classic network.
*   The read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network
parameters.help_zh:
要延期的经典网络连接地址，经典网络连接地址有两种：
* 经典网络内网地址
* 经典网络读写分离地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The retention days of the classic network endpoint. Valid values: **1 to 120**. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 经典网络连接地址保留天数，取值：**1~120**，单位：天
parameters.name: classic_expired_days

v1_parameters.help_en: The retention days of the classic network endpoint. Valid values: **1 to 120**. Unit: days
v1_parameters.help_zh: 经典网络连接地址保留天数，取值：**1~120**，单位：天
